summary: A worker in {place} asks what became of the tips customers actually left at the stadium.
realLife: A stadium barbecue operator told Denver Labor it had folded estimated tips into hourly pay, and workers recovered withheld tips.

weights: Actual gratuity receipts sharpen the dispute over the estimate.
